# Modules
```{r}
library(Seurat)
```

# Set working directory
```{r}
data_dir <- "D:/USERS/ELLIOT"
```

# Load diet Xenium objects
```{r}
xen1diet <- readRDS("D:/USERS/ELLIOT/xen1/Diet_obj_for_Pseudotime.rds")

xen2diet <- readRDS("D:/USERS/ELLIOT/xen2/Diet_obj_for_Pseudotime.rds")
```

# Load full Xenium objects
```{r}
xen1 <- readRDS("D:/USERS/ELLIOT/xen1/merged.samples.IndividualBanksy_AGFTrue_Lambda0.05_Resolution1.5_Annotated.rds")

xen2 <- readRDS("D:/USERS/ELLIOT/xen2/02.merged.samples.IndividualBanksy_AGFTrue_Lambda0.05_1.5res.rds")
```

# Get feature/gene list
```{r}
gene_panel <- rownames(xen1diet@assays$Xenium)

length(gene_panel) # QC
head(gene_panel)

write.csv(
  data.frame(gene = gene_panel),
  "Xenium_gene_panel.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# Get cell type list
```{r}
xen1_celltype <- sort(unique(xen1$cell_type))

write.csv(
  data.frame(cellType = xen1_celltype),
  "Xen1_celltype_list.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# Get cell type vs. count table
```{r}
cell_count <- as.data.frame(table(xen1$cell_type))

cell_count <- cell_count[order(cell_count$Freq, decreasing = TRUE), ]

write.csv(
  data.frame(cellType = cell_count),
  "CellType_count.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
